acid_splat.usage: 16-frame OneShot viscous splat: blob flattens, flings ropy droplets, then sizzles away; poison impacts.

arc_flicker.usage: 16 distinct crackling arc clusters (random-start Loop at high framerate); lightning motes, auras.

arcane_burst.usage: 16-frame OneShot: hexagram flash, expanding polygon rings and glyph shards flung out; arcane impacts.

arcane_glyphs.usage: 16 distinct angular runes (random-start flipbook, Framerate 0) for arcane motes and orbiting glyphs.

arcane_orb.usage: Looping 16-frame geometric core: counter-rotating nested polygons and a star around a bright eye.

beam_energy.usage: U-tiling filament energy for Beams; scroll with TextureSpeed.

bolt_strip.usage: U-tiling forked lightning channel with glow; Beams/Trails (animate TextureSpeed for crawl).

caustics.usage: Tiling underwater caustic light network; water fields/ground overlays (scroll or rotate).

clock_dial.usage: Ground decal: broken clock face with 12 hour marks, minute ticks, numeral glyphs and two hands; time fields.

core_plasma.usage: Looping 16-frame turbulent energy core; projectile hearts, charge points.

debris_chip.usage: Angular dark fragment silhouette with a hot rim.

drip_trail.usage: U-tiling viscous ribbon with hanging drips along the lower edge; poison trails.

droplet.usage: Teardrop water droplet with specular highlight; VelocityParallel spray.

dust_burst.usage: Heavy grit cloud with clumped edges; ground kick-up for body impacts.

dust_plume.usage: 16-frame OneShot heavy dust plume rising and spreading (bottom-anchored); earth casts, slams.

earth_fissure.usage: Ground decal: radial fissures splitting from an impact point with broken slab edges; earth fields/impacts.

explosion_fire.usage: 64-frame OneShot fire burst: flash -> lobed fireball -> rolling smoke -> gone.

flame_tongue.usage: Looping 16-frame irregular flame silhouette; flame shells, fire trails, fields.

flame_wisp.usage: Single static leaning flame lick; sparse secondary flames.

force_streak.usage: U-tiling speed lines for Trails/Beams on force and movement magic.

frost_crack.usage: Ground decal: branching frozen crack network with feathered frost, radial falloff; ice fields.

frost_mist.usage: Looping 16-frame curling cold fog with crystalline streaks; ice auras, fields, trails.

gear_mote.usage: Spoked cog wheel; time/clockwork motes and mechanical accents.

ghost_trail.usage: U-tiling tattered spectral ribbon with torn holes and trailing wisps; spirit trails, tethers.

glow_soft.usage: Soft energy bloom; core halos and charge glow.

glyph_chain.usage: U-tiling chain of runes between two rails; arcane beams, trails, binding tethers.

gust_strokes.usage: U-tiling curved brush-stroke gusts with hooked ends; wind trails and beams.

heat_haze.usage: Very low-contrast shimmer noise; faked distortion via low-opacity overlay.

hex_seal.usage: Ground decal: hexagonal ward seal, spoked lattice and corner glyphs; arcane fields, wards, shields.

hourglass_mote.usage: Hourglass icon with falling sand; time motes, slow/haste marks.

ice_glint.usage: Six-point crystalline glint with diffraction spikes; frost motes.

ice_shatter.usage: 16-frame OneShot burst of angular ice shards flying out and fading; ice impacts.

ice_trail.usage: U-tiling crystalline streak with faceted shards along the edge; ice trails and beams.

impact_frame.usage: Single-frame stylized impact: jagged star-burst with ink speed wedges, for 1-2 frame hit flashes.

impact_star.usage: Irregular radial flash for the first frames of an impact.

kinetic_burst.usage: 16-frame OneShot: hard concentric shock rings with radial speed lines punching outward; force impacts.

leaf_scrap.usage: 4 torn leaf/ash scraps (random-start flipbook) for debris caught in wind.

miasma.usage: Looping 16-frame lumpy toxic gas with dripping tendrils and dark pockets; poison clouds/fields.

plasma_orb.usage: Looping 16-frame ball of writhing electric filaments with hot center; lightning cores.

portal_rings.usage: Ground/portal decal: warped concentric rings around a void centre with orbiting stars; space fields.

pressure_wave.usage: 16-frame OneShot directional pressure crescent; compressed air front for force magic.

rift_tear.usage: 16-frame OneShot jagged tear in space: splits open on a void, holds, seals shut; space casts/portals.

ripple_ring.usage: 16-frame OneShot concentric ripples expanding and fading; flat (ground-facing) water impacts/fields.

rock_burst.usage: 16-frame OneShot: faceted rock chunks blast outward and arc down with a grit cloud; earth impacts.

rubble_trail.usage: U-tiling dragged grit and pebbles with a dust band; earth trails, ground-skimming projectiles.

rune_circle.usage: Industrial sigil: geared outer ring, angular glyph band, inner lattice. Ground casting circles.

sand_trail.usage: U-tiling stream of drifting sand grains thinning at the edges; time trails, decay.

scorch_lichtenberg.usage: Ground decal: branching Lichtenberg burn figure with charred core; lightning strikes/fields.

shard_trail.usage: U-tiling stream of broken-glass reality shards with void gaps; space trails, folds.

shockwave_ring.usage: Thin ragged ring with inner falloff; flat ring billboards and impact fronts.

sinew_trail.usage: U-tiling twisting fibrous strands; organic/body trails and tethers.

skull_mote.usage: Stylized horned skull icon; spirit motes, curse marks, death accents.

slash_arc.usage: Crescent slash with tapered tips and fibrous streaks.

smoke_billow.usage: 16-frame OneShot smoke puff that billows then thins; impact smoke, dissipation.

soul_burst.usage: 16-frame OneShot: hollow-eyed wisps tear outward from a dark core and dissolve; spirit impacts.

soul_sigil.usage: Ground decal: sunken eye within thorned rings and spectral script; spirit fields, curses, summons.

soul_wisp.usage: Looping 16-frame wailing ghost wisp: tattered rising flame shape with two hollow eyes and a mouth.

spark_burst.usage: 16-frame OneShot electrical discharge: white flash, radial forks racing out, flicker off.

star_mote.usage: Four-point star with long vertical spike; space motes, void sparkle.

time_ripple.usage: Looping 16-frame ticking ring: notched dial ring rotates in steps with trailing afterimages; time auras.

toxic_bubble.usage: Thick-rimmed bubble with crescent highlight and dark inner pool; poison motes, boiling fields.

toxic_pool.usage: Ground decal: irregular bubbling toxic pool with splatter rim and burst-bubble rings; poison fields.

trail_flame.usage: U-tiling ragged flame streak for Trails (TextureMode Wrap/Stretch).

void_orb.usage: Looping 16-frame black hole: dark core, bright lensed ring and spiralling accretion streaks.

ward_hex.usage: Tiling hexagonal barrier lattice with bright cell edges; shields, wards, force fields (MeshPart/Beam).

warp_implode.usage: 16-frame OneShot: rings and debris streaks collapse inward to a point, then a sharp pop; teleports.

water_orb.usage: Looping 16-frame sphere of churning water with caustic highlights and bright rim; water cores.

water_splash.usage: 16-frame OneShot crown splash: sheet rises, breaks into droplets, falls; water impacts.

water_trail.usage: U-tiling flowing water ribbon with foam edges and streaks; water trails/beams.

wind_swirl.usage: Looping 16-frame spiral of tapered gust strokes; wind cores, cyclones, auras.
